Shapio 3D Technologies is an additive manufacturing and product development company offering FDM & SLA 3D printing, bulk production, rapid prototyping, engineering and mechanical products, robotic parts, medical applications, and customized manufacturing solutions.

We support businesses and industries from idea to final product — step by step, including concept development, 3D modelling, prototyping, testing, manufacturing, and production.

We specialize in bulk 3D printing and fast production, helping businesses meet their requirements with quality products and quick dispatch timelines.

Our capabilities extend across multiple industries, including engineering, mechanical, robotics, medical, education, consumer products, and custom manufacturing.

Alongside client projects, we also focus on our own product research and development, developing innovative and practical products from concept to market-ready solutions.

Our mission is to make advanced manufacturing accessible, reliable, and efficient while helping businesses turn ideas into real-world products faster.
